# Start Fasteners by Hand Before Using Power Tools (VIDEO)


#### Description


Cordless power tools are stronger and more common than ever, and they help to speed up all kinds of automotive work. But cross-threading or stripping a fastener can bring progress to a halt in an instant. Start by hand-threading fasteners before reaching for faster tools, especially for critical nuts and bolts.
